sentences.text: No, the documents do not allow a 3% foreclosure (pre-closure) charge on this floating-rate home loan to an individual for a non-business purpose, because para 261(1) says a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, and the rule applies to this case.

The bank circular states that with effect from August 1, 2026, a foreclosure charge of 3% of the principal outstanding shall be levied on floating rate home loans to individuals for non-business purposes, including loans sanctioned on or after January 1, 2026, but the UCB Directions in force for this case say not to levy pre-payment charges.
